tuition_model.notes: Tuition (48,000 MAD regular rate) is waived for exchange students.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Fact sheet p.4 lists semester costs (some conditionally waived per agreement) and USD 1,500/semester pocket money rather than an official monthly local living range.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: No official monthly local living range published; fact sheet p.4 estimates USD 1,500/semester pocket money plus 3,810 MAD non-waived fees (housing 6,762 MAD and meal plan 12,100 MAD waived or charged per agreement).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Non-waived semester fees totaling 3,810 MAD (books 2,000 MAD, housing deposit 1,000 MAD, health insurance 550 MAD, residency card 160 MAD, printing 100 MAD); pre-registration (5,100 MAD), housing (6,762 MAD), and meal plan (12,100 MAD) may be waived depending on bilateral agreement.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Al Akhawayn University/2026-2027/AUI OIP Fact Sheet 2026-2027 .pdf#page=4

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Al Akhawayn University/2026-2027/AUI OIP Fact Sheet 2026-2027 .pdf#page=4
housing_availability.notes: Mandatory on-campus double-room dormitories for incoming exchange students.

housing_notes.value: Mandatory on-campus double-occupancy dorms (sex-segregated, no alcohol/drugs, Sun-Thu midnight curfew); housing fee 6,762 MAD/semester (or waived per bilateral agreement) plus 1,000 MAD deposit.
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Al Akhawayn University/2026-2027/AUI OIP Fact Sheet 2026-2027 .pdf#page=4

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Residency card fee of 160 MAD noted on fact sheet p.4; visa lead time and financial proof amounts not specified.

exchange_page_url.notes: Official AUI international experience / Office of International Programs portal.
